channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Norman Powell | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Norman Powell from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on Norman Powell, Bam Adebayo, Tyler Herro
item.description:
“Y’all know how good Norman is. He was an All-Star this year out there in the West. So for the Heat to be able to get a player like that with Bam [Adebayo], with Tyler [Herro] as the No. 1 and No. 2 options, all right. Let’s go.”

Dwyane Wade on Norman Powell, Bam Adebayo, Tyler Herro, Jul 16, 2025. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Norman Powell
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Ty Lue on Norman Powell:

“It’s been great to watch, just seeing all the hard work he’s put in to get to this point. He’s always talked about wanting to start but we had PG and Kawhi at those positions… He’s stepped into that role and he’s taking advantage of it… Very happy for him.”

Tyronn Lue on Norman Powell, Feb 2, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Michael Malone on Norman Powell
item.description:
Ryan Blackburn:Michael Malone:

“Obviously, Norman Powell just kicked our ass in the 4th.22 points.”

Michael Malone on Norman Powell, Oct 26, 2024. Source: Twitter @NBABlackburn.

item.title: Michael Malone on Norman Powell
item.description:
Michael Malone on Steph, Klay, Poole

“I go back to last year first round against Portland. Dame, CJ, Norman Powell. No disrespect to those guys, but this (Warriors trio) is on steroids.”

Michael Malone on Norman Powell, Apr 16, 2022. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Norman Powell
item.description:
Lue told Andscape on March 21.

“And that’s for sure. With the guys getting experience they’re getting now with those guys being out. And if you give me two stars and then Norman Powell, who’s a really good player, I can make something happen.”

Tyronn Lue on Norman Powell, Mar 29, 2022. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Chauncey Billups on Norman Powell
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Billups on Norm Powell:

“He's a great shooter. He's pretty competitive on the defensive end. He won't back down from anyone. So he's been fun. He's been a joy to coach.”

Chauncey Billups on Norman Powell, Nov 15, 2021. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Neil Olshey on Norman Powell
item.description:
Much of the personal detail was made with Powell’s impending free agency this summer in mind.

“We have a very brief time to make a strong and lasting impression on Norman,”

Neil Olshey on Norman Powell, Apr 21, 2021. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Norman Powell
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Nick Nurse on facing Norm Powell tomorrow:

“It will be strange... It feels like it's too soon to be seeing Norm coming in against us. Barely really over him being gone.”

Nick Nurse on Norman Powell, Mar 27, 2021. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Terry Stotts on Norman Powell
item.description:
Jay Allen:Terry Stotts on Norman Powell:

“He's a really good two-way player, and it's kinda what we need....he's going to have a major role with our team.”

Terry Stotts on Norman Powell, Mar 25, 2021. Source: Twitter @PDXjay.

item.title: Terry Stotts on Norman Powell
item.description:
Sean Highkin:Terry Stotts on Norm Powell:

“He's played an impact role on a championship team. That's why we got him. He's going to help us compete at a high level.”

Terry Stotts on Norman Powell, Mar 25, 2021. Source: Twitter @highkin.
